# Conversation AI API — operations

17 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `conversation-ai.create-action` — **Attach Action to Agent** — `POST /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions` (write, location)
  Creates and attach a new action for an AI agent.
- `conversation-ai.create-agent` — **Create an Agent** — `POST /conversation-ai/agents` (write, location)
  Creates a new AI agent for the location.
- `conversation-ai.create-agent-working-hours` — **Create Agent Working Hours** — `POST /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/working-hours` (write, location)
  Creates the working-hours configuration for an AI agent.
- `conversation-ai.delete-action` — **Remove Action from Agent** — `DELETE /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}` (write, location)
  Permanently deletes an action.
- `conversation-ai.delete-agent` — **Delete Agent** — `DELETE /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}` (write, location)
  Deletes an AI agent permanently.
- `conversation-ai.delete-agent-working-hours` — **Delete Agent Working Hours** — `DELETE /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/working-hours` (write, location)
  Deletes the working-hours configuration for an AI agent.
- `conversation-ai.get-action-by-id` — **Get Action by ID** — `GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}` (read, location)
  Retrieves detailed information about a specific action using its unique identifier.
- `conversation-ai.get-agent` — **Get Agent** — `GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}` (read, location)
  Retrieves a specific AI agent by its ID.
- `conversation-ai.get-agent-actions` — **List Actions for an Agent** — `GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions` (read, location)
  List for actions for an agent, including any `customApi` ("API Call") actions.
- `conversation-ai.get-agent-working-hours` — **Get Agent Working Hours** — `GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/working-hours` (read, location)
  Retrieves the working-hours configuration for an AI agent: the weekly schedule, the channels it applies to, the timezone mode, and the off-hours auto-reply and follow-up settings.
- `conversation-ai.get-generation-details` — **Get the generation details** — `GET /conversation-ai/generations` (read, location)
  Retrieves detailed information about AI responses including the System Prompt, Conversation history, Knowledge base, website, FAQ chunks, and Rich Text chunks.
- `conversation-ai.list-actions` — **List Actions for an Agent** — `GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/list` (read, location, deprecated)
  DEPRECATED.
- `conversation-ai.search-agent` — **Search Agents** — `GET /conversation-ai/agents/search` (read, location)
  Searches for AI agents based on various criteria including name, status, and configuration.
- `conversation-ai.update-action` — **Update Action** — `PUT /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}` (write, location)
  Updates an existing action's configuration — name, description, trigger condition and behaviour settings.
- `conversation-ai.update-agent` — **Update Agent** — `PUT /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}` (write, location)
  Updates an existing AI agent's configuration.
- `conversation-ai.update-agent-working-hours` — **Update Agent Working Hours** — `PUT /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/working-hours` (write, location)
  Fully replaces the working-hours configuration for an AI agent.
- `conversation-ai.update-followup-settings` — **Update Followup Settings** — `PATCH /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/followup-settings` (write, location)
